info.title: mnml API
info.description: Architecture rendering on the mnml engines. Every call spends credits from your prepaid API balance, topped up in dollars at developers.mnml.ai.

get.summary: The key's account: balance, tier, this key's settings and the limits in force.
The engines this key can render on, with their credit prices.

post.summary: Start a render. Send the image in the same call: a link, base64, or the file itself as multipart form data. Charged at the engine price when it starts; a failed render is refunded.

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Hold the answer up to this many seconds (1 to 90) while the render runs, and answer with the finished jobs in `jobs`. Still running when the time is up: a 202; read the job with GET /v2/jobs/{id}?wait=90 until it settles.

get.summary: Read a job: its status, its outputs as signed links that expire, what it was charged and refunded, and why it failed. A job and its outputs are kept 7 days.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The job id a create call answered with.

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Hold the answer up to this many seconds (1 to 90) until the job settles; it answers as soon as it does. Call again while status is queued or processing.

get.summary: Follow a job as Server-Sent Events, for one that outlasts ?wait: a job event with the job as it stands and each time it changes, then one last event (done with the settled job, timeout after 10 minutes, or error) and the stream closes. Every event's data is JSON; done's and job's are the job as GET /v2/jobs/{id} reads it.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The job id a create call answered with.

200.description: The stream: `event: job`, then one of `event: done`, `event: timeout` or `event: error`. A `: ping` comment keeps it alive while nothing changes.

post.summary: Stop a queued or running job. Refunded at once if it had not started; otherwise refunded if nothing is delivered.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The job id a create call answered with.

get.summary: A job's output, at the signed link GET /v2/jobs/{id} gave. No key: the signature is the credential, until it expires.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The job id a create call answered with.

parameters.name: exp
parameters.description: When the link expires (part of the link).

200.description: The file: an image, watermarked on plans that mark downloads, or a video.

post.summary: Legacy alias of /v2/renders. The same engine. `prompt_mode=edit` runs as an edit.

x-mnml-legacy.note: The same engine. `prompt_mode=edit` runs as an edit.

fields.name: image
fields.desc: The source image: JPEG, PNG or WebP.

fields.name: prompt
fields.desc: What to render. Each mode has a default when it is left out.

fields.name: expert_name
fields.desc: The mode. Default `exterior`; a value outside the list is refused. `imageType` is read the same way.

fields.name: prompt_mode
fields.desc: `edit` changes the image as the prompt says instead of rendering it anew; it needs a `prompt`.

fields.name: aspect_ratio
fields.desc: The output shape. `square`, `vertical`, `horizontal` and `match_input_image` are read too; a value outside the list is refused.

fields.name: seed
fields.desc: A whole number, 0 or more, to repeat a result.

fields.name: reference_image_1
fields.desc: Up to four reference images, `reference_image_1` to `reference_image_4`.

fields.name: reference_mode_1
fields.desc: What each reference steers, `reference_mode_1` to `reference_mode_4`. `composition` and `inspiration` are read too. Default `auto`.

fields.name: reference_image
fields.desc: One style reference, as the style-transfer route takes it.

fields.name: <setting>
fields.desc: Any setting of the engine's panel, by its snake_case name (`render_style`, `time_of_day`, `camera_angle`, …), matched to a value or label. A value outside the panel is refused.

body.message: Not enough credits for this generation.
